[RTIM.14.8] **Single eval path.** The interpreter **must**
drive the real engine and assert against the real observation surface — the mock
clock, assertion as the driver, and the stream-callback / introspection
surface ([RTIM.6]). It **must not** be a shadow or parallel evaluator: a second
evaluation path drifts from production semantics. Fresh-engine-per-case makes
the isolation free.
